info.title: Meridian IT-PMO
info.summary: Read a governed project portfolio, and the trail of how it got that way
info.description:
The surface other systems read. It is versioned in the path: the day the shape has to change it becomes /api/v2, so that nobody has to guess. Authentication is a key issued per connected system, carrying explicit scopes; the product never stores the key itself, only its fingerprint.

There is no write surface yet, and that is deliberate: a scope is only published once a route honours it. Declaring one earlier would advertise a door that does not exist and imply it is guarded.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Issued from Administration → Connected systems. `Authorization: Bearer <key>` is accepted too.

x-scopes.read:portfolio: Read the portfolio — projects, schedule, money, risks, benefits
x-scopes.read:audit: Read the audit trail — every recorded decision and change

get.summary: The audit trail — every recorded decision and change
get.description: Its own scope, because it is the most sensitive read in the product: a system that copies the portfolio into a warehouse has no reason to carry away who approved what. Filters: entity, entityId, action, limit, before.

401.description: No key, an unknown key, or a revoked key — the three are indistinguishable on purpose

403.description: The key is live but does not carry the scope this route requires

get.summary: The whole portfolio the key is entitled to read
get.description: The same output the screens are drawn from — deliberately, because two projections would drift apart at the first change and an integrator would then be reading numbers nobody can see in the product. Money is in millions; dates are ISO-8601 calendar dates.

get.description: Open to any live key, whatever its scopes, so an integrator can read what they are missing without writing to an administrator.
